benchmark.scope: Six predetermined old saved endpoint pairs, twelve calls each, baseline then candidate, pinned offline Linux ARM runtime, one CPU. Cache cleared before every timed call; only internal reuse contributes. Native endpoint cache primed in both variants. No profiler. Local fixed-order static observations, not a general or full-solver speedup or trajectory equivalence result.

boundaries: The LRU limit bounds retained entries, not total process RSS or simultaneous temporary computations.
No native inventory, activation, weight, selected feature, work result, caller budget or solver acceptance decision is cached.
Declaration/source checks are before/after comparisons, not continuous filesystem monitoring or arbitrary-Python tamper resistance.
Benchmark/test launchers are recorded at exit but not bound by their pre-run declarations; the benchmark launcher was independently inspected and hashed before result review.
The preceding cProfile diagnostic had inconsistent call counts; it supplies no speed or call-share claim here.
Native coefficients, derivative arithmetic and other constitutive inputs remain conditional; cache equivalence adds no physical calibration.
The original uncached temporal study remains separate; this increment neither changes its frozen inputs nor repairs its missing adaptive histories.

implementation.preserved: Exact feature arithmetic, strict raw coordinate validation before lookup, per-call selected-feature and arithmetic-budget admission, native candidate inventories and coefficients, force/path checks and complete work validation.
implementation.storedValues: Immutable exact rational numerator/denominator integers; fresh dictionaries and Fractions per call.

independentBenchmarkReview.numericalScope: Complete saved public work records and native E/g/H representations match at six supplied old-trajectory endpoint pairs under the exact profile. Native arrays are retained as hashes rather than independently re-evaluated. Within-variant repeat equality and per-call clearing are enforced by the reviewed hash-bound driver. This review executes no native mechanics or new motion.
independentBenchmarkReview.provenanceLimit: The original frozen benchmark declaration omits the launcher; both actual receipts match the launcher identity independently retained by the design review, but a declaration-bound launcher start/end identity proof is absent.
independentBenchmarkReview.timingScope: Exact sums/statistics of retained integer per-call CPU and wall nanoseconds. Ratios describe this sequential fixed-order static workload with twelve cold-geometry-cache calls per pair; process elapsed, startup, validation/serialization outside timed calls and cache_clear are excluded. No randomized-run inference, universal or full-solver speedup, trajectory equivalence, convergence or physical calibration claim.

independentImplementationReview.memoryScope: A process-wide LRU retains at most 256 keys, each at most four raw finite binary64 points, and at most nine pairs of immutable integers. This is an entry bound, not a measured byte/RSS bound. Concurrent misses may compute duplicate temporary arithmetic; process resource limits remain separate. Native inventories, weights, selected feature, path/force, work result and caller budget are not memoized.
independentImplementationReview.trustScope: Ordinary supported inputs and detached outputs; Python private helpers/class monkeypatching are not a security boundary. Main running-study sources remain unchanged. Differential checks establish arithmetic preservation for tested cases; they do not establish speedup or full-trajectory agreement.
